caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular scene bordered with floral and leaf patterns in shades of pink, red, green, yellow, and blue. The central section is split into two main areas. On the left, there is a body of blue water with a group of brown and white ducks swimming. Behind the water, a large building with tall, pointed spires and several windows is colored in beige and light brown, and surrounded by green trees. In the background, the sky is shaded light blue with some cloud-like areas. The right side of the center shows a group of five white rabbits with pink ears and brown markings, sitting on green grass beneath a large tree with a thick, twisted brown and yellow trunk and green foliage. A smaller, tan-colored house with windows stands behind the rabbits and is partially obscured by trees. The background behind the rabbits includes a green hill and additional trees. The border framing the scene includes intricate floral patterns with large pink, red, and green flowers and leaves, some blue accents, and brown shading along the outer edge. The lower left corner of the drawing contains the text "Westchester County," and the lower right corner features the name "Wm P. Shearwood."
title: Hooked Rug
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
